subject: Orphaned GCP Marketplace usage lines — allocation & VAT evidence request
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@skydock.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Orphaned GCP Marketplace usage lines — allocation & VAT evidence request

Hi Oliver,

Hope you’re well. We discovered a set of usage lines on the September GCP Marketplace invoice that are not mapped to any Skydock customer entity in our ledger (lines: sellerListingId 987654321 / meteringId 0xA3F4). Those charges are appearing under our marketplace payout but there’s no marketplace customer_id attached on our end.

I attached a daily usage extract (gcp_daily_usage_20260901-09.csv) and our seller integration manifest for the listing. Can you confirm whether these meterings belong to an older Skydock account or if they originated from a test/legacy project that should be reattributed? We also need the VAT/tax ID you want associated for these lines if they should be reallocated — EU VAT handling differs depending on whether the buyer entity is commercial or consumer.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm sellerListingId ownership and provide the buyer_account_id for affected lines.
- If reallocation is required, Skydock sends a signed reconciliation request and we coordinate a credit memo with GCP.
- Provide the tax evidence (VAT number or reverse-charge confirmation) so we can apply correct VAT handling in the journal entries.

Timeline: we’d like confirmation by end of Thursday 9/17 to hit the marketplace payout cycle next week. If you need more time, please let us know and we’ll flag this internally.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Billing & Marketplace Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachments: gcp_daily_usage_20260901-09.csv (CSV), seller_integration_manifest.pdf (PDF)
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@skydock.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-billing@skydock.com
Date: 2026-09-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orphaned GCP Marketplace usage lines — allocation & VAT evidence request

Thanks Kim — appreciate the heads-up. I pulled the sellerListingId from our side and that listing is still owned by our older US entity (Skydock, Inc.). The metering IDs look like they were emitted by a legacy integration we retired in Q1 but hadn’t fully removed from the marketplace configuration.

Action I can take immediately:
- I’ll dig the buyer_account_id out of our order logs and send you a CSV with the mapping by EOD today.
- For VAT: these specific buyers are commercial EU customers (we have VAT IDs on file). I’ll attach the VAT list and KYC reference.

One ask: when you send the reconciliation request to GCP please reference our invoicing alias (acme-billing@skydock.com) and include the sellerListingId and the period (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-09). We’ll sign whatever form the marketplace requires.

Oliver
Head of Finance Operations
Skydock Analytics
Attachments: skydock_vat_list_20260916.pdf (PDF)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orphaned GCP Marketplace usage lines — internal next steps

Quick internal note:

Kim — thanks for flagging. To prepare the reconciliation package we need the following extracted and bundled into one zip for the external request:
- Ledger export (GL lines) for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-09 filtered by marketplace sellerListingId 987654321
- Per-day metering CSV (the attached gcp_daily_usage_20260901-09.csv looks good, confirm mediantimestamp col exists)
- HubSpot deal export for the affected buyer_account_ids (I see a few potential matches; include hubspot-98765-deal-export.xlsx)

Marissa — can you pull the GL export and mark any manual adjustments we’ve already recorded? Tag as INTERNAL:marketplace-orphaned when you save. Vivek, FYI — we may need to create a temporary credit allowance in AR if GCP issues a delayed credit memo.

I’ll draft the reconciliation request language for GCP and Skydock to sign.

-Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Sr. Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: GCP Marketplace Support <marketplace@google.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver@skydock.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orphaned GCP Marketplace usage lines — ticket #MP-20260916-8462

Hi Kimberly / Oliver,

Thanks for the attachments. We investigated ticket MP-20260916-8462 and found duplicated metering events tied to a deprecated meter adapter. Outcome and options:

1) Reallocation: If Skydock provides a signed reallocation request and buyer_account_id mapping, we can reassign the usage to the correct buyer in marketplace metrics and issue a corrective credit on the next settlement cycle (estimated 7–10 business days after request approval).

2) Credit memo: If reallocation is not possible, we can issue a credit memo against Skydock’s seller payout for the affected period. Credits will be visible on the next payout statement.

Required artifacts for reallocation path (please attach with the request):
- Signed reconciliation request (PDF with seller signature)
- Buyer_account_id CSV (buyer_account_id, meter_id, usage_date, units)
- Seller confirmation of VAT IDs / reverse-charge docs (for EU tax handling)

We’ve attached the marketplace reconciliation template (marketplace_recon_template.xlsx). If you need the ticket escalated for a faster settlement, please request escalation and provide the business reason (e.g., to preserve month-end cash collected).

Regards,
GCP Marketplace Support
Attachments: marketplace_recon_template.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@skydock.com>, marketplace@google.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-18T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orphaned GCP Marketplace usage lines — reconciliation request submitted

Oliver / GCP team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Oliver — received your VAT list and KYC PDF this morning and they match the buyer_account_ids we extracted.

We uploaded the completed marketplace_recon_template.xlsx and a signed reconciliation request (signed by Oliver) into the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4d-example and copied the CSV (hubspot-98765-deal-export.xlsx) to the ticket.

Next steps / owners:
- GCP Marketplace: confirm receipt of the recon package and confirm whether reallocation or credit memo will be used (please respond to ticket MP-20260916-8462).
- Skydock: please keep acme-billing@skydock.com on the thread for the eventual credit memo.
- Redwood Finance (Marissa / Vivek): hold AR adjustments until GCP confirms the credit amount — if GCP estimates a timeline >10 business days, we’ll create a temporary allowance entry.

If GCP requires escalation to preserve this week’s payout window, we’ll escalate with business justification. Target: resolve and post any credit by 2026-09-27.

Thanks all — I’ll follow up once GCP confirms the outcome.

Best,
Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Billing & Marketplace Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
